name: Hatsushiba Kisa
source:
Kisa is the childhood friend of [url=/c717]Rei[/url] and is actually a genius. She’s quite quiet most of the time and is in the same class as the protagonist but she is friendly to everyone.  She and Rei often get told that they look like a couple but in fact there isn’t any kind of romantic feelings between them.

[Edited from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/31/preview-diamic-days/]Liemyx's blog[/url].]
